prompt: Arrange the steps of a cache-aside read for key user:42.
explanation: Cache-aside always starts on the cache side with GET; a miss sends the service to the database; the loaded record is written back with SET plus a TTL; and only then does the caller receive the value, so the next read hits the cache.

options.text: On a miss, load the record from the database
SET user:42 with the loaded record and an expiry
Return the record to the caller
